scientific_integrity: The geometric 28-line equations and 12+16 decomposition are acknowledged as prior inputs; finite enumerations do not establish the uniform theorem without its Frobenius proof.
scientific_limitations: Covers diagonal quartics in odd characteristic and the bitangent scheme, not general plane quartics or characteristic two. Explicit geometric bitangent formulas are classical; priority for the arithmetic cycle classification remains subject to independent checking and an equivalent historical Galois-theta formula could exist.
title: Frobenius orbit classification of bitangents on diagonal plane quartics
